description: The frame around a daily game: its name, today's number and date, how far through the rounds the player is, and, once they finish, a countdown to the next one. The game itself is the children, so any round (a CloserGame, a GuessReveal, your own) sits…

## @interlace/daily-puzzle

Installed to `components/ui/games/daily-puzzle.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/games/daily-puzzle';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/daily-puzzle

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
